job.title: PLoRA: An NDP-Enhanced Pooled-Memory System for Cost-Efficient Multi-LoRA Serving
job.selection_reason: 1000超adapterのmulti-LoRA servingをCXL/NVLink級pooled memoryとnear-data processingで扱い、GPU主導load/store interfaceとcost modelでLoRA/attention execution strategyを選択する。H100でS-LoRA比decode latency平均6.6倍低減を報告し、CXL pooled memoryのLLM serving応用として高価値。
